title: Export Template Manager issues in Godot engine
key_points: Export Template Manager is missing VisionOS in the per-platform download list
Export Template Manager does not resume partial downloads when downloading templates for selected platforms
EditorExportPlatformAndroid causes freeze when attempting to quit editor
limitations: Issues are specific to certain versions of Godot engine and may vary based on system configurations.
Reproduction steps may require detailed information about the user's project setup and environment.
asserts: The Export Template Manager feature in Godot engine has compatibility issues with VisionOS, does not resume partial downloads for selected platforms, and causes a freeze when attempting to quit editor on Android platform exports.
